changeSet.comment: Shadow for product_tag M:N join table (Tag↔Product per FD#9). Empirically NO unique constraint on (product_id, tag_id) per CDR R3; concurrent writes from Grails + catalog-service produce silent duplicate rows if Tag writes are in scope per T1 audit.
